subject: Local and global names
notes: kb/Work PB1047 / PB1243 (w68z). cite.py --check 8.4.6.2.1 'If the name is declared in source element B, the item in source element B is the referenced item' -> OK §8.4.6.2.1 3) a); 'The item in source element A if the name is declared in source element A' -> OK 3) b) 1. The contained program's name map used to be ONE flat tier (its own names + the containers' globals), so a local X and a container's global G.X were co-candidates (COBOL1639 ambiguous), for condition-names too. Every inherited global item now carries its nesting depth (DataBinder.InheritGlobalSubtree) and SymbolTable.NearestDeclaring narrows the QUALIFIED survivor set to the nearest declaring element — ReferenceResolver.ResolveUnqualified, DataBinder.QualifiedCandidates and ConditionBinder.ConditionOf ask it; two survivors in that one element stay ambiguous (negative). Siblings on the same rule, fixed: a nearer DATA-name now hides a farther global INDEX-name (SymbolTable.IndexCandidates) and a farther global CONSTANT-name (DataBinder.DropShadowedConstants, depth-aware). Golden legs: I X=LOC (3a), I C=FALSE (3a, 88), I IX=7 (3a across name classes), I XG=MID (qualification first, then 3b1), J X=MID / J C=TRUE (3b1), T K=MDK (3b1, constant vs data). kb/Work PB4196: a REPORT SECTION entry is a data-name of the source element that declares its report, so it takes part in the same ranking: SymbolTable.NearestDeclaringData / NearestDeclaringConditions (the narrowings, asked by TryResolveUnqualified, QualifiedCandidates and QualifiedConditionCandidates) leaves no survivor when ReportScope.NearerEntryHides finds a report entry of a NEARER source element that the written qualifiers reach, so the callers' report-item refusal (COBOL5092, §13.8.6.2.3) names the entry instead of the container's lone GLOBAL data item or condition-name being used; SymbolTable.NearerDataNameHides (index-names, capacity registers) and DataBinder.DeclaredNearerThan (constants) ask it too. A qualifier that reaches only the container's item, and a nearer data item against a farther GLOBAL report entry, keep their old answers. kb/Work PB4219 (wave 20261819, the data-name / condition-name sibling): rule 1's set is 'all names', so a condition-name and a data-name of one spelling compete; NearestDeclaringData leaves no survivor when SymbolTable.NearerConditionNameHides finds a nearer condition-name the written qualifiers reach, and NearestDeclaringConditions none when NearerDataNameHides finds a nearer data-name. A contained program's own 88 RELF hides its container's GLOBAL data item RELF (DISPLAY RELF: COBOL1639 'is a condition-name', it displayed the container's 7) and its own data item RELF hides the container's GLOBAL condition-name RELF (IF RELF: COBOL2318, it tested the container's condition). retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/Model/SymbolTable.cs#NearestDeclaringNamed (NearestDeclaringNamed was split into NearestDeclaringData and NearestDeclaringConditions (kb/Work PB4219, the cross-class ranking); the two new members carry its witness) kb/Work PB4219 review R1-1 (w20261821a). cite.py --check 8.4.6.2.1 'If the name is declared in source element B, the item in source element B is the referenced item' -> OK 3) a). A contained program's own data item RELF hides its container's GLOBAL condition-name RELF in the condition-only positions too: SET Format 4 (COBOL1639, 'names a data item, not a condition-name') and SEARCH ALL's bare WHEN (COBOL1639, same wording) through ConditionBinder.ReportMisqualifiedCondition, and SEARCH ALL's relation (COBOL1965, SR8) through SearchAllFormat2Rules' condition-name receiving-operand arm, which now asks the same predicate. kb/Work PB4433 (w20261824c): the hiding-data-item arm is for the positions that admit ONLY a condition-name. A bare operand of IF, EVALUATE or PERFORM UNTIL admits a data item, so ConditionBinder.AnalyzeBareOperand no longer reaches ReportMisqualifiedCondition for a word a nearer data item hides (ConditionBinder.NamesHidingDataItem): the reference is the data item's (8.4.6.2.1 3) a)) and the value arm reports its own verdict, e.g. COBOL2096 for a subscript on a scalar (8.4.2.3.3 SR2), where it had been told 'this position requires a condition-name' (COBOL1639). retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Reports.cs#NearerReportEntryHides (kb/Work PB2357 split DataBinder.Reports.cs: the same code, unchanged, now lives in ReportSectionBinder.cs (the binder), ReportModel.cs (the model types) and ReportScope.cs (the visible-report lookups)) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Compiler/Binding/DataBinder.Linkage.cs#InheritGlobalSubtree (kb/Work PB2359 moved the member, unchanged, out of the DataBinder.Linkage.cs partial: the LINKAGE / EXTERNAL / GLOBAL binder is LinkageBinder, and the cell-backing forcer and the inherited-name tier went to the data binder files that own the name tables)
